claims.text: Event runs 10 Nov to 1 Dec; live Tuesday 10 Nov; no start time given
Godzilla takes over Storm Point: damaged buildings, Heat Ray strikes; a Care Package in strike zones gives a custom Devotion with a heat ray
Event Pass: free track (Octane Jet Jaguar epic skin and more) and Premium track 950 AC (Catalyst Ghidorah 1991 iconic skin, Gravity Beam Prowler legendary)
10 Legend skins incl. Bloodhound 'Godzilla 2026'; 10 legendary weapon skins; Dorsal Dagger universal melee from event packs
Platforms PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, PC (EA app, Epic, Steam)

why: A big licensed crossover in a free-to-play shooter with a large Gulf player base; starts in three days.
